name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - § 15, partie introductive - Am 116
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 15. Rejects the blanket restoration of the Council reductions under Heading 2b and any blanket increases above the draft budget; calls for each programme and body to be assessed separately and for any strictly necessary reinforcement to be fully offset by savings elsewhere; rejects the Citizens, Equality, Rights and Values programme, Creative Europe MEDIA, the European Institute for Gender Equality and Commission prerogative lines; considers that strictly operational civil-protection expenditure may be supported only where it demonstrates clear cross-border added value and measurable results;
